author: GamingBolt
description:
The Vietnam War and World War II’s battles across Europe were two very different conflicts. But, beyond setting, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam brings plenty of significant differences over its WW2-era predecessor. 

From frontline structure and faction identity, to weapon handling changes and more ways to control the flow of battle, here are fifteen differences between Hell Let Loose: Vietnam and Hell Let Loose.
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam vs. Hell Let Loose - 15 BIG Changes

author: GamingBolt
description:
Mortal Kombat is on vacation, Tekken has fallen on hard times, and Street Fighter still reigns supreme after all these years. And while many fighting games have challenged for one's attention since then, few have been as hype as Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls – a 2.5D title from none other than Arc System Works of Guilty Gear fame, together with PlayStation and Marvel Games.

With its gorgeous art style and over-the-top action, it may seem like the Marvel vs Capcom sequel that we never got, but there is a lot more to it. Let's dive into 15 things you should know before it launches on August 6th for PS5 and PC.
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
